params.note: range = 2048 * n_dot_tiles - 1. Operands are symmetric in fp16 mode (both 2048-byte tiles), unlike the int8 path where the activation is masked at 2047 and the weight at 1023.
params.purpose: Establish the fp16 HMX tile sequence at a shape whose scalar reference is trivially checkable, before weight repacking, deep-K accumulation or matmul_epilogue integration are built on it.
